# GitHub Actions Badges

Add these badges to your README.md to show the status of your CI/CD pipeline:

```markdown
[![CI/CD Pipeline](https://github.com/zacharyblevins/TimberTask/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/zacharyblevins/TimberTask/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![codecov](https://codecov.io/gh/zacharyblevins/TimberTask/branch/main/graph/badge.svg)](https://codecov.io/gh/zacharyblevins/TimberTask)
[![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
```

## Additional Badges (optional)

```markdown
[![Crates.io](https://img.shields.io/crates/v/timber-task.svg)](https://crates.io/crates/timber-task)
[![Downloads](https://img.shields.io/crates/d/timber-task.svg)](https://crates.io/crates/timber-task)

```
